items.title: Unified Vision-Language Modeling via Concept Space Alignment
items.title_zh: 通过概念空间对齐实现统一视觉-语言建模
items.summary: V-SONAR extends the text-only SONAR embedding space to vision through a post-hoc alignment pipeline that maps an existing vision encoder into it, achieving competitive text-to-video retrieval. With the OMNISONAR decoder it surpasses state-of-the-art vision-language models on video captioning, and the resulting V-LCM matches them on captioning and QA while outperforming them in 61 of 62 tested languages.

items.title: A Very Big Video Reasoning Suite
items.title_zh: 超大规模视频推理套件
items.summary: The authors introduce the Very Big Video Reasoning dataset, spanning 200 curated reasoning tasks and over one million video clips, roughly three orders of magnitude larger than existing datasets. They pair it with VBVR-Bench, a verifiable evaluation framework using rule-based, human-aligned scorers, and report early signs of emergent generalization to unseen reasoning tasks.

items.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of LLM Unlearning Robustness under Multi-Turn Interaction
items.title_zh: 多轮交互下 LLM 遗忘鲁棒性的综合评估
items.summary: The paper examines whether LLM unlearning remains stable in interactive settings through self-correction and dialogue-conditioned querying, and finds that knowledge appearing forgotten in static evaluation can often be recovered through interaction. Stronger unlearning improves apparent robustness but often produces behavioral rigidity rather than genuine knowledge erasure, suggesting static evaluation may overestimate real-world effectiveness.

items.title: How Robustly do LLMs Understand Execution Semantics?
items.title_zh: LLM 对执行语义的理解有多鲁棒？
items.summary: The authors probe whether LLMs rely on internal world models or pattern matching by perturbing code and inputs in a program-output prediction task. DeepSeek-R1-family reasoning models stay stable at 38% to 67% accuracy, while GPT-5.2 falls from 99% on unperturbed CRUXEval by 20% to 24% under perturbation, and exception prediction is especially weak.

items.title: FHIRPath-QA: Executable Question Answering over FHIR Electronic Health Records
items.title_zh: FHIRPath-QA：基于 FHIR 电子健康记录的可执行问答
items.summary: FHIRPath-QA is an open dataset and benchmark of more than 14,000 patient- and clinician-phrased questions paired with validated FHIRPath queries over MIMIC-IV on FHIR. With o4-mini, text-to-FHIRPath synthesis cut average token usage 391x versus retrieval-first prompting and lowered failure rates from 0.36 to 0.09, while supervised fine-tuning raised query synthesis accuracy from 27% to 79% for 4o-mini.

items.title_zh: FHIRPath-QA：基于 FHIR 电子健康记录的可执行问答

items.title: Structured Prompt Language: Declarative Context Management for LLMs
items.title_zh: 结构化提示语言：面向 LLM 的声明式上下文管理
items.summary: SPL is a declarative, SQL-inspired language that treats LLMs as generative knowledge bases and context windows as constrained resources, adding token budgets, an automatic query optimizer, EXPLAIN-style transparency, RAG and persistent memory in one framework. It ships a formal grammar and two pip-installable packages, claims a 65% average reduction in prompt boilerplate, and surfaces a 68x cost spread across model tiers before execution.

items.title: Automating the Detection of Requirement Dependencies Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型自动检测需求依赖
items.summary: LEREDD combines retrieval-augmented generation and in-context learning to detect diverse dependency types directly from natural-language requirements. It reports 0.93 accuracy and 0.84 F1 against two state-of-the-art baselines, with average relative F1 gains of 94.87% and 105.41% for the Requires dependency, and releases an annotated dataset of 813 requirement pairs across three systems.

items.title: Efficient Continual Learning in Language Models via Thalamically Routed Cortical Columns
items.title_zh: 通过丘脑路由皮层柱实现语言模型的高效持续学习
items.summary: TRC² is a decoder-only architecture that makes continual learning a property of the backbone by combining stacked cortical columns, a thalamic pathway for selective inter-column communication and a hippocampal pathway for event-selective retrieval, delayed surprise-based writing and replay-driven consolidation. Across task-sequential language modeling on C4, WikiText-103 and GSM8K it reduces cumulative forgetting versus Transformer, Mamba, MoE, DeepSeek and continual-learning baselines, while remaining competitive on throughput and training cost.

items.title: VeRO: A Harness for Agents to Optimize Agents
items.title_zh: VeRO：让智能体优化智能体的运行框架
items.summary: VeRO is an outer harness for optimizing target agents that provides versioned snapshots, budget-controlled evaluation and structured execution traces, released with the VeRO-Bench suite and code on GitHub.

items.title: MASRubric: Auditing Information Flow in Multi-Agent Systems with Failure-Distilled Pitfall Rubrics
items.title_zh: MASRubric：以失败蒸馏陷阱评分规则审计多智能体系统信息流
items.summary: MASRubric distills failed multi-agent trajectories into a reusable bank of pitfall rubrics, then retrieves and checks applicable criteria on each intermediate message to broadcast, revise or withhold it. It reports average accuracy gains of up to 2.83 points on math reasoning and 1.74 points on code generation, and the rubric bank transfers to a stronger backbone without re-mining.

items.title: Beyond the Click: A Framework for Inferring Cognitive Traces in Search
items.title_zh: 超越点击：推断搜索中认知轨迹的框架
items.summary: The paper infers cognitive traces from behavioral search logs with a multi-agent LLM system grounded in Information Foraging Theory and validated by human experts. It annotates three public datasets with over 530,000 cognitive labels across 50,000 sessions; on MovieLens the cognitive model improves F1 by up to 6.6% over a behavioral baseline, while gains are near zero on AOL.

items.title: Query Disambiguation via Answer-Free Context: Doubling Performance on Humanity's Last Exam
items.title_zh: 借助无答案上下文消解查询歧义：在 Humanity's Last Exam 上性能翻倍
items.summary: The authors find that rewriting a question to reduce ambiguity using answer-free grounding context improves accuracy without changing the answer, and that the gain cannot be fully recovered by inference-time prompting alone. Using gpt-oss-20b to rewrite a subset of Humanity's Last Exam raises gpt-5-mini accuracy from 0.14 to 0.37.

items.title: Constitutional Black-Box Monitoring for Scheming in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体阴谋行为的宪法式黑盒监控
items.summary: The authors study constitutional black-box monitors, prompted classifiers that detect scheming in LLM agents from externally observable inputs and outputs, optimized on synthetic trajectories from two generation pipelines. Monitors selected purely on synthetic data generalize to 7,500 held-out ControlArena trajectories, but performance saturates quickly, with simple prompt sweeps matching more extensive optimization and further pushing leading to overfitting.

items.title: TopoEdge: Topology-Grounded Agentic Framework for Edge Networking Code Generation and Repair
items.title_zh: TopoEdge：面向边缘网络代码生成与修复的拓扑锚定智能体框架
items.summary: TopoEdge represents each target network topology as a router-level graph embedded by a contrastively trained GNN, retrieves a verified reference configuration and driver, and assembles them into a topology-grounded RAG context. Planning, generation and verification agents then run an execution-centric generate-verify-repair loop over an FRRouting Topotest/pytest harness.

items.title: Demystifying Group Relative Policy Optimization: Its Policy Gradient is a U-Statistic
items.title_zh: 解构组相对策略优化：其策略梯度是一个 U 统计量
items.summary: The paper shows that the GRPO policy gradient is a U-statistic, deriving its mean squared error, finite-sample error bound and asymptotic suboptimality gap. It finds GRPO asymptotically equivalent to an oracle policy gradient algorithm and derives a universal scaling law for choosing group size, with experiments supporting the theory.

items.title: CaDrift: A Time-dependent Causal Generator of Drifting Data Streams
items.title_zh: CaDrift：随时间变化的因果漂移数据流生成器
items.summary: CaDrift is a synthetic data-stream generator based on structural causal models that drifts mapping functions to create distributional and covariate shifts, and uses causal interventions to model occasional perturbations. Experiments show classifier accuracy drops after distributional shift events and then gradually recovers, and the framework is available on GitHub.

items.title: Adversarial Intent is a Latent Variable: Stateful Trust Inference for Securing Multimodal Agentic RAG
items.title_zh: 对抗意图是隐变量：面向多模态 Agentic RAG 的状态化信任推断
items.summary: The paper models security for multimodal agentic RAG as a partially observable Markov decision process with adversarial intent as a latent variable. Its Modular Trust Agent reports a 6.50x average reduction in attack success rate across 43,774 instances with negligible utility cost.

items.title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 终端能力扩展的数据工程
items.summary: The authors present Terminal-Task-Gen, a synthetic task generation pipeline for terminal agents, and analyze filtering, curriculum learning, long-context training and scaling. Training Nemotron-Terminal models initialized from Qwen3 8B, 14B and 32B on the resulting Terminal-Corpus lifts Terminal-Bench 2.0 scores from 2.5% to 13.0%, 4.0% to 20.2% and 3.4% to 27.4% respectively, with checkpoints and most synthetic data open-sourced.

items.title: Importance of Prompt Optimisation for Error Detection in Medical Notes Using Language Models
items.title_zh: 提示优化对语言模型检测病历错误的重要性
items.summary: Automatic prompt optimization with Genetic-Pareto, or GEPA, raised medical-note error-detection accuracy from 0.669 to 0.785 with GPT-5 and from 0.578 to 0.690 with Qwen3-32B, approaching physician performance and setting state of the art on the MEDEC benchmark.

items.title: CiteAudit: You Cited It, But Did You Read It? A Benchmark for Verifying Scientific References in the LLM Era
items.title_zh: CiteAudit：你引用了它，但你真的读过吗？LLM 时代科学参考文献核验基准
items.summary: The authors introduce CiteAudit, a benchmark and multi-agent detection framework for hallucinated citations that decomposes verification into metadata extraction, memory lookup, web-based retrieval and a final judgment. Built on a large-scale, human-validated multi-domain dataset, it reportedly outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs and commercial baselines, and the code is released.

items.title: Probing to Refine: Reinforcement Distillation of LLMs via Explanatory Inversion
items.title_zh: 以探询促精炼：通过解释反转进行大语言模型强化蒸馏
items.summary: The paper proposes a distillation framework that combines Explanatory Inversion, in which the student model articulates the logic behind answers, with Explanatory GRPO and a Dialogue Structure Utility Bonus. Using Gemma-7b as the student, it reports a 20.39% average gain over zero-shot and 6.02% over state-of-the-art distillation baselines.

items.title: Multi-Sourced, Multi-Agent Evidence Retrieval for Fact-Checking
items.title_zh: 面向事实核查的多源多智能体证据检索
items.summary: WKGFC treats an authorized open knowledge graph as the core evidence source: an LLM agent retrieves the most relevant knowledge subgraphs for a claim, supplements them with web content, and runs the process as a Markov decision process tuned through prompt optimization. The authors position the approach as addressing the limits of text-similarity retrieval for multi-hop fact-checking.

items.title: Draft-Thinking: Learning Efficient Reasoning in Long Chain-of-Thought LLMs
items.title_zh: Draft-Thinking：在长思维链大模型中学习高效推理
items.summary: Draft-Thinking learns a model-adapted draft chain of thought through progressive supervised fine-tuning and two-stage reinforcement learning, avoiding post-hoc trajectory compression or an explicit length penalty. With 847 training problems and 120 RL optimization steps, its draft mode cuts MATH500 average response length from 5,668 to 986 tokens (82.6%) while reaching 90.6% accuracy versus 93.0% for the original long-CoT model.

items.title: Contextual Invertible World Models: A Neuro-Symbolic Agentic Framework for Colorectal Cancer Drug Response
items.title_zh: 情境可逆世界模型：面向结直肠癌药物反应的神经符号智能体框架
items.summary: The authors present a Contextual Invertible World Model that couples a quantitative machine-learning emulator with an LLM reasoning layer, using a curated Sanger GDSC subset of 83 samples. Through inverse reasoning and in-silico CRISPR perturbations it identifies mutant KRAS dominance over the APC/Wnt axis in 5-fluorouracil resistance and a PIK3CA paradox where repair increases chemoresistance.

items.title: TARSE: Test-Time Adaptation via Retrieval of Skills and Experience for Reasoning Agents
items.title_zh: TARSE：面向推理智能体的技能与经验检索测试时自适应
items.summary: TARSE frames clinical question answering as an agent problem with two retrievable resources: reusable skills such as guidelines and protocols, and verified reasoning trajectories from solved cases indexed by step-level transitions. At test time a step-aware retriever selects items and the model is lightly adapted to align its intermediate reasoning, yielding consistent gains over strong medical RAG and prompting-only baselines.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.title_zh: context-mode：为 AI 编程智能体优化上下文窗口
items.summary: Context-mode is a TypeScript tool for optimizing the context window of AI coding agents, sandboxing tool output for a claimed 98% reduction, persisting session memory and enforcing routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.title_zh: Panniantong/Agent-Reach：让 AI Agent 读取全网内容
items.summary: Agent-Reach is a command-line tool that lets AI agents read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without API fees.

items.title: NVIDIA/skills
items.title_zh: NVIDIA/skills：面向 NVIDIA 产品的智能体技能库
items.summary: NVIDIA/skills is a collection of Agent Skills for NVIDIA products that can be installed into Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents to run Physical AI, robotics, simulation, CUDA and RAG workflows end to end.

items.title: appeeky/aso-skills
items.title_zh: aso-skills：面向应用商店优化的 AI Agent 技能集
items.summary: A collection of AI agent skills for App Store Optimization and app marketing, intended to help tools such as Cursor or Claude Code with keyword research, metadata optimization, competitor analysis and app growth.

items.title: AgentsMesh/AgentsMesh
items.title_zh: AgentsMesh：可调度上百个 AI 编程智能体的工作平台
items.summary: AgentsMesh is a Go-based AI agent workforce platform for running a hundred AI coding agents across your own machines, with one console to schedule, isolate and steer them.

items.title: phuryn/pm-skills
items.title_zh: pm-skills：覆盖产品管理全流程的智能体技能市场
items.summary: A marketplace of more than 100 agentic skills, commands and plugins covering product management work from discovery and strategy through execution, launch and growth.

items.title: OpenAI announces Frontier Alliance Partners
items.title_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Frontier Alliance 合作伙伴
items.summary: OpenAI announced Frontier Alliance Partners to help enterprises move from AI pilots to production with secure and scalable agent deployments.

items.title: Why we no longer evaluate SWE-bench Verified
items.title_zh: 我们为何不再评估 SWE-bench Verified
items.summary: OpenAI says SWE-bench Verified is increasingly contaminated and mismeasures frontier coding progress, citing flawed tests and training leakage in its analysis. It recommends SWE-bench Pro instead.

items.title: Writing code is cheap now
items.title_zh: 如今写代码的成本很低
items.summary: A post in Simon Willison's Agentic Engineering Patterns guide argues that writing code has become cheap now.

items.title: Feb 24, 2026 Product Insights OmniDocBench is Saturated, What’s Next for OCR Benchmarks? Read
items.title_zh: OmniDocBench 已饱和，OCR 基准的下一步是什么？
items.summary: A LlamaIndex product insights post asks what comes next for OCR benchmarks now that OmniDocBench is saturated.

items.title: Feb 26, 2026 Product Open Source Creating a Deal Sourcing Agent with LlamaAgents Builder Read
items.title_zh: 用 LlamaAgents Builder 构建交易寻源智能体
items.summary: The post, tagged as product and open source, walks through creating a deal-sourcing agent with LlamaIndex's LlamaAgents Builder.

items.title: What Claude Code chooses
items.title_zh: Claude Code 会如何做选择
items.summary: The post presents a benchmarking and "ground control" resource for developer-tool providers that aims to show what coding-agent choices look like and to test what helps agents succeed.

items.title: Introducing the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock
items.title_zh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中为智能体引入有状态运行时环境
items.summary: OpenAI describes a stateful runtime environment for agents in Amazon Bedrock that adds persistent orchestration, memory and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows.

items.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Amazon 宣布战略合作
items.summary: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership that brings OpenAI's Frontier platform to AWS, expanding AI infrastructure, custom models and enterprise AI agents.

items.title: We gave terabytes of CI logs to an LLM
items.title_zh: 我们把数 TB 的 CI 日志交给大模型
items.summary: The post describes giving an AI agent a SQL interface to billions of CI log lines stored in ClickHouse, and how the team ingests, stores and queries about 1.5 billion log lines per week.
